title: Finite type-(c) incidence indexing data
statement: For $r\geq0$, use the canonical finite incidence category $I_r:=\operatorname{AsSmall}(\operatorname{Incidence}(r))$ of inert maps from $[r]$ to $[1]$ and $[0]$, with exactly the edge and vertex objects and commuting incidence arrows of Definition 3.1.13. Package a boundary map $b_r:N(I_r)\to N(\Delta^{\mathrm{op}})$ together with a proof that $b_r$ is the canonical incidence projection, and package an apex extension $\bar b_r:\Delta^0\star N(I_r)\to N(\Delta^{\mathrm{op}})$ with apex $[r]$, boundary $b_r$, and each mixed leg equal to the prescribed inert base edge, using [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], [def-coef-monoidal-infinity-category], and [def-coef-infinity-relative-cone].
